title: SWF: DefineButton2 drops grouped artwork and never emits filters/blend on button states
description: packages/swf/src/buttons.ts. (a) Group flatten missing: the char-ID pre-pass (:210) and the state-collection loop (:389) iterate frame.displayObjects directly instead of routing through flattenDisplayObjects (as frames.ts:339 and sprite.ts:328/491/561 do). A type:'group' in a button keyframe is skipped in the pre-pass and objCharIdMap.get(obj.id) is undefined at :396 -> continue -> the group's children get no char IDs and vanish from the button. Fix: wrap both loops with flattenDisplayObjects. (b) buildButtonRecord (:108-142) hardcodes ButtonHasFilterList(bit4) and ButtonHasBlendMode(bit5) to 0 with no code to append a FILTERLIST/blend byte after the CXFORM; DefineButton2 supports both since SWF8. Also colorEffect is only captured for instance/text states not shape/bitmap (:408-410), and alpha/visible=false are not captured. Fix: set bit4/bit5 and append FILTERLIST/blend byte; capture colorEffect for shape/bitmap and alpha/visible. Acceptance: group-in-button and filter-on-button-state e2e (no such test exists today). Confidence: confirmed.
